verdict.rationale: Square documents a broad public REST API covering payments, refunds, disputes, payouts, invoices, subscriptions and catalog. It adds webhooks, idempotency and OAuth or personal access tokens with scopes, plus a GraphQL API, an interactive API Explorer with a sandbox, official SDKs on GitHub, and an agent-oriented llms.txt that a probe confirmed returns HTTP 200. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of driving the API, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404).
